title: Creamy Polish Mushroom Gratin
description: A rich and creamy Polish-inspired dish featuring sautéed mushrooms, topped with a crunchy gratin crust.

ingredients.name: luscious mushrooms
ingredients.notes: Any variety of mushrooms will do

ingredients.name: polish butter
ingredients.notes: Salted or unsalted, whichever you prefer

ingredients.name: ovoli cheese
ingredients.notes: Or substitute with any other type of cheese

instructions: Sauté the sliced mushrooms in polish butter until they're tender and lightly browned.
Add garlic, salt, and black pepper to taste, and cook for an additional minute.
Transfer the mushroom mixture to a baking dish and top with grated ovoli cheese.
Sprinkle crumbled gratin on top of the cheese.
Drizzle white wine over the gratin crust.
Bake in the preheated oven until the gratin is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
